series.name: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)
series.notes: Official Daikin global SM-TS3 'Simple Self-Diagnosis by Malfunction Code' PDF (pp.1-6) for Sky Air / RA type indoor. High (official). Broader letter+digit universe (A0/A7...UJ). No PK-specific table exists — global chart applies to PK-sold Sky Air/split families.

title.ur: External protection device activate ho gaya

meaning.en: A protection device wired to the terminal strip (or the indoor T1-T2 circuit) has operated and stopped the unit.
meaning.ur: Terminal strip par jude ya indoor T1-T2 circuit ke protection device ne chala kar unit rok diya hai.

causes.en: External protection device connected to the terminal strip is doing its job (its circuit is open).
causes.ur: Terminal strip par laga external protection device apna kaam kar raha hai (uski circuit khuli hai)

causes.en: T1-T2 of the indoor unit is activated (external thermostat/float circuit closed).
causes.ur: Indoor unit ka T1-T2 activate ho gaya hai (external thermostat/float circuit band hai).

solutions.en: Identify which external device is wired in and check why it tripped (float switch, external thermostat, safety stat).
solutions.ur: Dekhein kaun sa external device juda hai aur woh trip kyun hua (float switch, external thermostat, safety stat).

solutions.en: Reset the external device; if its circuit stays open, fix that device before restarting the AC.
solutions.ur: External device reset karein; agar uski circuit khuli rahe to AC dobara chalane se pehle us device ki kharabi theek karein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased from those causes. A0/E0 are the unified external/outdoor protection-device pair.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi causes se parafrase kiye gaye hain. A0/E0 bahar aur outdoor protection device ka jora hai.

meaning.en: The airflow swing flap (louver) motor did not operate correctly.
meaning.ur: Hawa ke swing flap (louver) motor ne sahi tarah kaam nahi kiya.

causes.en: Defective swing flap motor.
causes.ur: Swing flap motor kharab

causes.en: Defective connection cable, or the airflow-direction flap-cam is deformed/not engaging.
causes.ur: Connection cable kharab, ya airflow-direction flap-cam ki shape kharab hai ya sahi tarah fit nahi ho raha

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check the flap mechanism for jamming and free it; inspect the motor cable connection.
solutions.ur: Flap mechanism jam to nahi, check karein aur azad karein; motor cable ki connection bhi dekh lein.

solutions.en: Replace the swing flap motor, or the indoor PCB if the motor tests good.
solutions.ur: Swing flap motor badlein, ya motor theek nikle to indoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Applies to units with motorised swing flap (cassette/some splits).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh un units par lagta hai jin mein motorised swing flap ho (cassette aur kuch splits).

title.en: Power supply or AC input overcurrent malfunction
title.ur: Power supply ya AC input overcurrent kharabi

meaning.en: The supply voltage is wrong or an AC input overcurrent was detected.
meaning.ur: Supply voltage ghalat hai ya AC input mein zyada current detect kiya gaya

causes.en: Defective power supply voltage (too low/high, unstable).
causes.ur: Power supply voltage kharab hai (bahut kam ya zyada, be-kaar-sa).

causes.en: Defective connection on the signal line, or defective wiring.
causes.ur: Signal line par connection kharab ya wiring kharab

solutions.en: Measure the mains at the terminal board against the rated voltage; fix supply/stabiliser problems.
solutions.ur: Terminal board par mains voltage ko rated value se naaphein; supply/stabiliser ki masla hal karein.

solutions.en: Inspect and re-terminate the signal line and internal wiring.
solutions.ur: Signal line aur internal wiring check karke dobara terminate karein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. PK supply-voltage swings make this a plausible field code.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. PK mein supply voltage ke utaar-chadhaav ki wajah se yeh field code aam milta hai.

meaning.en: The indoor electronic expansion valve (EXV) or its drive circuit is not working.
meaning.ur: Indoor electronic expansion valve (EXV) ya uska drive circuit kaam nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Defective wiring or relay cables to the EXV.
causes.ur: EXV tak ki wiring ya relay cables kharab

causes.en: Defective electronic expansion valve coil.
causes.ur: Electronic expansion valve ki coil kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check and repair the EXV wiring/relay cables; verify coil resistance.
solutions.ur: EXV wiring/relay cables check karke theek karein; coil ka resistance bhi verify karein.

solutions.en: Replace the EXV coil/valve; replace the indoor PCB if the drive output is missing.
solutions.ur: EXV coil/valve badlein; drive output na ho to indoor PCB bhi badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Indoor-side counterpart of E9 (outdoor-side EXV coil).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions paraphrased likhi gayi hain. Yeh code E9 ka counterpart hai - E9 condenser unit ka EXV coil, aur yeh wall unit ka EXV.

meaning.en: The electric heater (26WH thermostat) tripped because the heater overheated.
meaning.ur: Electric heater (26WH thermostat) trip ho gaya kyunke heater zyada garam ho gaya

causes.en: 26WH heater overheat thermostat is activated.
causes.ur: 26WH heater overheat thermostat faal hai

causes.en: Defective relay cables feeding the heater.
causes.ur: Heater ko chalane wale relay cables kharab

solutions.en: Check heater airflow and the 26WH thermostat; do not bypass it.
solutions.ur: Heater ka airflow aur 26WH thermostat check karein; use bypass na karein.

solutions.en: Replace defective heater relay cables and the heater element if it overheats repeatedly.
solutions.ur: Heater relay cables kharab hon to badlein, aur baar baar zyada garmi ho to heater element bhi badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Heat-pump units with electric heater option; PK heat-cool splits have no heater, so rarely seen in PK.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh heat-pump units ke liye hai jin mein electric heater option hota hai; PK ki heat-cool splits mein heater nahi hota, is liye PK mein kam milta hai.

meaning.en: The humidifier system (optional accessory) reported a leak or control fault.
meaning.ur: Humidifier system (optional accessory) ne leak ya control fault kiya

causes.en: Humidifier unit (optional accessory) is leaking.
causes.ur: Humidifier unit (optional accessory) leak kar raha hai

causes.en: Defective drain piping (installed with upward slope, etc.).
causes.ur: Drain piping kharab (ooper ki taraf jhuki hui lagi ho, wagaira).

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Fix the drain piping slope and clear any blockage.
solutions.ur: Drain piping ka rukh (slope) theek kar lein aur blockage saaf kar lein.

solutions.en: Stop the leak in the humidifier unit; replace the indoor PCB only if the fault persists.
solutions.ur: Humidifier unit ki leak band karein; fault phir bhi rahe to hi indoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Humidifier is an optional accessory - not applicable to standard PK splits.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Humidifier optional accessory hai - aam PK splits par lagu nahi hota.

title.ur: Capacity setting kharab hona (indoor unit PCB)

meaning.en: The indoor unit PCB does not know the configured capacity (capacity setting adaptor issue).
meaning.ur: Indoor unit PCB ko jo capacity set ki gayi hai uska pata nahi chalta (capacity setting adaptor ki masla).

causes.en: The capacity setting adaptor was not installed when the PCB was replaced.
causes.ur: PCB badalne waqt capacity setting adaptor nahi lagaya gaya

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Fit/correct the capacity setting adaptor for the model's capacity.
solutions.ur: Model ki capacity ke mutabiq capacity setting adaptor lagayein/theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor unit PCB if the adaptor is correct and the error remains.
solutions.ur: Adaptor theek hai aur error phir bhi aata hai to indoor unit PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Typically appears right after a PCB swap during service.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh aksar service ke dauran PCB badalne ke foran baad aata hai.

title.en: Transmission failure between indoor unit PCB and sub PCB
title.ur: Indoor unit PCB aur sub PCB ke darmiyan transmission nakami

meaning.en: The link between the indoor unit main PCB and its sub PCB is broken.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit main PCB aur uske sub PCB ka link toot gaya hai.

causes.en: Defective connector between the indoor unit PCB and sub PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB aur sub PCB ke darmiyan connector kharab

causes.en: Connector or harness between the two boards is loose, corroded or a bent pin breaks the link.
causes.ur: Dono boards ke darmiyan ka connector ya harness dhila hai, zang lage ya pin tedhi hone se rabta toot gayi

causes.en: The sub PCB has failed, so the main indoor board gets no reply from it.
causes.ur: Sub PCB hi kharab ho to main indoor board ko uska jawab nahi milta.

solutions.en: Reconnect and inspect the connector between the two boards.
solutions.ur: Dono boards ke darmiyan connector dobara lagayein aur check karein

solutions.en: Replace the sub PCB or main indoor PCB if the connection tests good.
solutions.ur: Connection theek nikle to sub PCB ya main indoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. The chart gives a single supposed cause for C1 (connector between the boards) - kept as-is. Seen on indoor units with a separate sub board.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions paraphrased likhi gayi hain. Chart mein C1 ke liye sirf ek hi wajah batayi gayi hai (dono board ke darmiyan ka connector) - waisa hi rakha gaya hai. Yeh alag sub board wali indoor units mein dekha gaya hai.

title.en: Fan motor sensor or fan control driver malfunction
title.ur: Fan motor sensor ya fan control driver kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor fan motor sensor signal or the fan control driver is faulty.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor ka sensor signal ya fan control driver kharab hai.

causes.en: Defective fan PCB.
causes.ur: Fan PCB kharab

causes.en: Defective connection of the capacity setting adaptor.
causes.ur: Capacity setting adaptor ka connection kharab

causes.en: Field setting error.
causes.ur: Field setting ghalat

solutions.en: Reconnect the capacity setting adaptor and verify the field settings.
solutions.ur: Capacity setting adaptor dobara lagayein aur field setting verify kar lein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan PCB / fan control driver.
solutions.ur: Fan PCB ya fan control driver badal dein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi se parafrase kiye gaye hain.

meaning.en: The discharge-air (outlet) temperature sensor circuit is faulty.
meaning.ur: Discharge air (outlet) temperature sensor ka circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: Defective connector contact.
causes.ur: Connector ka contact kharab

causes.en: Defective discharge air thermistor.
causes.ur: Discharge air thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the thermistor connector and check resistance against the chart.
solutions.ur: Thermistor connector dobara laga kar chart ke mutabiq resistance check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace the indoor PCB if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; sensor theek nikle to indoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Distinct from C4/C5 (heat exchanger thermistors) and C9 (room air).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh C4/C5 (heat exchanger thermistors) aur C9 (room air) se alag hai.

title.en: Room temperature thermistor in remote controller abnormality
title.ur: Remote controller ka room temperature thermistor kharab

meaning.en: The room-temperature sensor built into the remote controller is faulty.
meaning.ur: Remote controller mein laga room temperature sensor kharab hai.

causes.en: Defective room temperature thermistor in the remote controller.
causes.ur: Remote controller ka room temperature thermistor kharab hai.

causes.en: Defective remote controller PCB.
causes.ur: Remote controller PCB kharab

causes.en: External factor such as electrical noise.
causes.ur: Electrical noise jaisa external factor

solutions.en: Keep the remote away from heat sources; power-cycle to clear noise effects.
solutions.ur: Remote ko garmi ki source se door rakhein; noise ka asar hatane ke liye power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Replace the remote controller (thermistor/PCB) if the fault remains.
solutions.ur: Fault phir bhi rahe to remote controller (thermistor/PCB) badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Only for remotes with built-in room sensor (BRC/ARC classes).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Sirf un remotes ke liye jin mein built-in room sensor ho (BRC/ARC classes).

title.ur: Outdoor unit ka protection device activate ho gaya

meaning.en: A protection device connected to the outdoor unit PCB operated.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit PCB par jude protection device chal para

causes.en: Defective protection device connector contact.
causes.ur: Protection device ke connector ka contact kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check and reseat the protection-device connector on the outdoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB par protection device ka connector check karke dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor unit PCB if the connector is sound.
solutions.ur: Connector theek ho to outdoor unit PCB badlein

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. E0 is the unified outdoor-side protection-device code (A0 is the indoor/terminal-strip side).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions paraphrased likhi gayi hain. E0 protection device ka unified code hai jo condenser unit par lagta hai (A0 wall unit/terminal-strip side wala hai).

meaning.en: The low-pressure switch opened during operation.
meaning.ur: Low pressure switch chalanay ke doran khul gaya.

causes.en: Abnormal drop in low pressure (refrigerant shortage, blocked filter/drier, TXV issue).
causes.ur: Low pressure mein ghalti se kami (refrigerant ki kami, band filter/drier, TXV ki masla).

causes.en: Defective low pressure sensor, or its connector contact.
causes.ur: Low pressure sensor kharab ya uska connector contact kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check suction pressure and look for refrigerant shortage or line restrictions; repair leaks and recharge.
solutions.ur: Suction pressure check karein, refrigerant ki kami ya line mein restriction dhoondhein; leak theek karke dobara gas bharrein.

solutions.en: Verify the low pressure sensor signal and connector; replace sensor or outdoor PCB as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Low pressure sensor ka signal aur connector check karein; diagnosis ke mutabiq sensor ya outdoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. E4 = low pressure switch on Daikin (NOT indoor fan as some generic tables claim).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Daikin par E4 = low pressure switch hai (kuch generic tables isay indoor fan kehte hain, woh ghalat hai).

meaning.en: The electronic expansion valve (EXV) coil circuit is open or the coil is defective.
meaning.ur: Electronic expansion valve (EXV) ki coil ka circuit khuli hai ya coil kharab hai

causes.en: Disconnected connector on the electronic expansion valve.
causes.ur: Electronic expansion valve ka connector khula (disconnect) ho gaya

causes.en: Defective electronic expansion valve coil.
causes.ur: Electronic expansion valve ki coil kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit control PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ka control PCB kharab hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect the EXV connector and check coil continuity/resistance.
solutions.ur: EXV connector dobara lagayein aur coil ki continuity/resistance check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the EXV coil; replace the outdoor control PCB if the drive output is missing.
solutions.ur: EXV coil badlein; drive output na ho to outdoor control PCB bhi badlein

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Outdoor-side counterpart of A9.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh A9 ka outdoor-side wala version hai.

meaning.en: The low-pressure switch itself is defective or its circuit is broken.
meaning.ur: Low pressure switch khud kharab hai ya uski circuit toot gayi hai.

causes.en: Defective low pressure switch.
causes.ur: Low pressure switch kharab

causes.en: Broken wire in the switch circuit.
causes.ur: Switch ki circuit mein wire tooti hai

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB, or bad connector contact.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab ya connector ka contact kharab

solutions.en: Test the low pressure switch and its wiring for continuity.
solutions.ur: Low pressure switch aur uski wiring ki continuity test karein.

solutions.en: Repair broken wires/reseat connectors; replace the switch, or outdoor PCB if the circuit is at fault.
solutions.ur: Tooti wire theek karein/connector dobara lagayein; switch badlein, ya circuit kharab ho to outdoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. H4 = switch/circuit fault; E4 = the switch actuated on pressure.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. H4 = switch ya circuit ki kharabi; E4 = pressure par khulne wala switch.

title.ur: Compressor motor overload thermistor kharab hai

meaning.en: The compressor motor overload (OL) thermistor circuit is faulty.
meaning.ur: Compressor motor ke overload (OL) thermistor ka circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: Defect of the compressor motor overload thermistor.
causes.ur: Compressor motor overload thermistor mein kharabi hai.

causes.en: Defective connector contact.
causes.ur: Connector ka contact kharab

solutions.en: Check OL thermistor resistance and the connector seating.
solutions.ur: OL thermistor ka resistance aur connector ki fitting check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the OL thermistor/harness if it is off-spec.
solutions.ur: OL thermistor/harness ghalat nikle to badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Sensor-side counterpart of E5 (OL activation).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh E5 ka sensor-side wala version hai (OL activation).

meaning.en: A refrigerant pressure sensor (high/low) reported an invalid signal.
meaning.ur: Refrigerant pressure sensor (high/low) ne ghalat signal diya hai.

causes.en: Defective pressure sensor connector contact.
causes.ur: Pressure sensor ka connector contact kharab

causes.en: Defective pressure sensor.
causes.ur: Pressure sensor kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the pressure sensor connector and compare readings with gauges.
solutions.ur: Pressure sensor connector dobara lagayein aur gauge se reading compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace the pressure sensor if the reading stays invalid.
solutions.ur: Reading ghalat hi rahe to pressure sensor badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. JA/JC are the more specific high/low pressure sensor codes.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. JA/JC zyada specific high/low pressure sensor codes hain.

meaning.en: The compressor current (CT) sensor signal is invalid.
meaning.ur: Compressor current (CT) sensor ka signal ghalat hai.

causes.en: Defective current sensor.
causes.ur: Current sensor kharab

causes.en: Defective compressor.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Compare the sensor reading against a clamp-meter reading on the compressor line.
solutions.ur: Sensor ki reading ko compressor line par clamp meter ki reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace the current sensor, compressor, or outdoor PCB as the diagnosis indicates.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq current sensor, compressor ya outdoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi se parafrase kiye gaye hain.

title.en: Low-pressure saturated temperature sensor system fault
title.ur: Low-pressure saturated temperature sensor system kharab

meaning.en: The sensor system that estimates low-pressure saturation temperature is faulty.
meaning.ur: Low pressure ki saturation temperature andaza lagane wala sensor system kharab hai.

causes.en: Defective connection of the thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connection kharab

causes.en: Defective thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check thermistor connectors and measure resistance against the chart.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ke connector check karein aur chart ke mutabiq resistance naaphein.

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace the outdoor PCB if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; sensor theek nikle to outdoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Computed (soft) sensor used on VRV-class controls.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh computed (soft) sensor VRV-class controls par istemal hota hai.

meaning.en: The suction pipe temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Suction pipe temperature sensor ki reading had se bahar hai.

causes.en: Defective connection of the thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connection kharab

causes.en: Defective suction pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Suction pipe thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the connector and measure resistance against the temperature chart.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara baitha karein aur temperature chart ke mutabiq resistance naaphein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace the outdoor PCB only if the sensor is good.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; outdoor PCB sirf tab badlein jab sensor theek ho.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Outdoor suction-line sensor (VRV/Sky Air class).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh outdoor suction-line sensor hai (VRV/Sky Air class).

meaning.en: A refrigerant-circuit thermistor (liquid pipe side) read out of range.
meaning.ur: Refrigerant circuit ka thermistor (liquid pipe side) ki reading had se bahar hai.

causes.en: Defective connection of the thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connection kharab

causes.en: Defective liquid pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Liquid pipe thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check the thermistor connector and measure resistance against the chart.
solutions.ur: Thermistor connector check karein aur chart ke mutabiq resistance naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace the outdoor PCB if it tests good.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; woh theek nikle to outdoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Sister code of J8 (also liquid/refrigerant circuit thermistor).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh J8 ka sister code hai (woh bhi liquid/refrigerant circuit thermistor hai).

meaning.en: The high-pressure sensor reported an invalid signal or is mis-wired.
meaning.ur: High pressure sensor ne ghalat signal diya ya uski wiring ghalat hai.

causes.en: Defective connector contact.
causes.ur: Connector ka contact kharab

causes.en: Low pressure sensor connected by mistake in place of the high pressure sensor.
causes.ur: Ghalti se high pressure sensor ki jagah low pressure sensor laga diya gaya.

causes.en: Defective high pressure sensor, or defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: High pressure sensor kharab ya outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Verify the sensor plugged into the high-pressure port is the correct sensor; reseat the connector.
solutions.ur: High pressure port par laga sensor hi sahi hai ya nahi, check karein; connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Replace the high pressure sensor; replace the outdoor PCB if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: High pressure sensor badlein; sensor theek nikle to outdoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Common service trap: sensors swapped during replacement.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Service mein aam ghalti: sensors badalte waqt aapas mein badal diye gaye.

meaning.en: The low-pressure sensor reported an invalid signal or is mis-wired.
meaning.ur: Low pressure sensor ne ghalat signal diya ya uski wiring ghalat hai.

causes.en: Defective connector contact.
causes.ur: Connector ka contact kharab

causes.en: High pressure sensor connected by mistake in place of the low pressure sensor.
causes.ur: Ghalti se low pressure sensor ki jagah high pressure sensor laga diya gaya.

causes.en: Defective low pressure sensor, or defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Low pressure sensor kharab ya outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Verify the correct sensor is fitted on the low-pressure port; reseat the connector.
solutions.ur: Low pressure port par sahi sensor laga hai ya nahi, check karein; connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Replace the low pressure sensor; replace the outdoor PCB if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: Low pressure sensor badlein; sensor theek nikle to outdoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi se parafrase kiye gaye hain.

meaning.en: The inverter system (power transistor stage) reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter system (power transistor stage) ne fault dikhaya hai.

causes.en: Shortage of power supply capacity.
causes.ur: Power supply ki capacity kam

causes.en: Defective power transistor.
causes.ur: Power transistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Confirm the mains supply can carry the unit's starting current (check voltage dip under load).
solutions.ur: Mains supply unit ka starting current utha sakti hai ya nahi, check karein (load ke dauran voltage dip bhi dekh lein).

solutions.en: Inspect the power transistor stage; replace the outdoor PCB/power module as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Power transistor stage check karein; diagnosis ke mutabiq outdoor PCB/power module badal dein

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Repairable at board level by HVAC electronics specialists (IPM/transistor swap).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh board level par HVAC electronics specialist theek kar sakte hain (IPM/transistor badal kar).

meaning.en: The inverter PCB self-check failed (blown fuse or board fault).
meaning.ur: Inverter PCB ka self-check nakam hua (fuse uth gaya ya board kharab).

causes.en: Defective compressor wiring, or defective outdoor unit fan motor loading the board.
causes.ur: Compressor wiring kharab, ya outdoor unit ka fan motor kharab aur board par load daal raha hai.

causes.en: Blown fuse on the inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB par fuse ura hua hai

causes.en: Defective inverter PCB or outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB ya outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Find why the fuse blew: megger the compressor windings and check the outdoor fan motor first.
solutions.ur: Dekhein fuse kyun utha: pehle compressor windings ka megger test karein aur outdoor fan motor check karein.

solutions.en: Repair the shorted component, then replace the blown fuse/inverter PCB.
solutions.ur: Short wala component theek karein, phir phata hua fuse/inverter PCB badal dein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Do not just replace the fuse - find the short first.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Sirf fuse mat badlein - pehle short ki wajah dhoondein.

meaning.en: An instantaneous overcurrent was detected on the inverter AC output.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke AC output par foran zyada current detect kiya gaya

causes.en: Compressor start-up failure (mechanical lock).
causes.ur: Compressor start-up nahi hua (mechanical lock).

causes.en: Refrigerant overcharge, or shortage of power supply capacity.
causes.ur: Refrigerant zyada bhara hua, ya power supply ki capacity kam

causes.en: Defective compressor, defective inverter PCB, or defective inverter unit.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab, inverter PCB kharab ya inverter unit kharab

solutions.en: Verify charge level and supply capacity; try a controlled restart only after checking the compressor is not locked.
solutions.ur: Gas ki qadar aur supply capacity check karein; compressor jam to nahi hai, yeh dekh kar hi controlled restart karein.

solutions.en: If the compressor is mechanically seized, replace it; otherwise replace the inverter PCB.
solutions.ur: Agar compressor mechanically jam ho gaya hai to use badlein; warna inverter PCB badlein

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Distinct from L5 (DC output overcurrent) and L8 (sustained overcurrent).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh L5 (DC output overcurrent) aur L8 (lagataar overcurrent) se alag hai.

meaning.en: Sustained overcurrent flowing to the inverter compressor was detected.
meaning.ur: Inverter compressor ki taraf lagatar zyada current behne ka pata chala

causes.en: Compressor overloaded, or wiring disconnection inside the compressor coil.
causes.ur: Compressor par zyada load, ya compressor coil ke andar wiring toot gayi

causes.en: Disconnected compressor wiring (terminal).
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring (terminal) khuli ho gayi

causes.en: Defective inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check compressor terminal connections and winding resistance (also megger to earth).
solutions.ur: Compressor ke terminal connections aur winding resistance check karein (earth par megger bhi karein).

solutions.en: Repair wiring; replace the compressor if windings are shorted to earth, or the inverter PCB if the compressor tests good.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek karein; windings earth se short hon to compressor badlein, ya compressor theek nikle to inverter PCB badlein

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi se parafrase kiye gaye hain.

title.ur: Inverter compressor start nahi hota (stall prevention)

meaning.en: The compressor failed to start; stall prevention stopped the attempt.
meaning.ur: Compressor start nahi hua; stall prevention ne yeh koshish rok di.

causes.en: Stop valve not opened.
causes.ur: Stop valve khuli nahi

causes.en: Defective compressor, or error in the wire connections to the compressor.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab, ya compressor ke wire connections mein ghalti

causes.en: Large differential pressure before compressor start; defective inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Compressor start se pehle bohat zyada pressure ka farq, ya inverter PCB kharab

solutions.en: Open the stop valves fully and equalise pressure before retrying.
solutions.ur: Dobara koshish se pehle stop valves poori tarah kholein aur pressure barabar karein.

solutions.en: Check compressor wiring; replace the compressor or inverter PCB as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Compressor wiring check karein; diagnosis ke mutabiq compressor ya inverter PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. A classic after-installation code when valves were left closed.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Installation ke baad aam code, jab valves band rehne diye gaye hon.

meaning.en: The inverter power transistor failed its check.
meaning.ur: Inverter power transistor ka check nakam raha.

causes.en: Defective power transistor.
causes.ur: Power transistor kharab

causes.en: Defective compressor.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab

causes.en: Defective inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB kharab

solutions.en: Test the power transistor module and the compressor windings before replacing parts.
solutions.ur: Parts badalne se pehle power transistor module aur compressor windings test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the defective power transistor/board; replace the compressor if it shorted the stage.
solutions.ur: Kharab power transistor/board badlein; compressor ne stage ko short kar diya ho to compressor bhi badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Board-level repair territory (IPM/power module).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh board level ki repair hai (IPM/power module).

title.en: Transmission malfunction between control and inverter PCB
title.ur: Control PCB aur inverter PCB ke darmiyan transmission kharabi

meaning.en: Communication between the control PCB and the inverter PCB was lost or corrupted.
meaning.ur: Control PCB aur inverter PCB ke darmiyan rabta khatam ya kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Defective connection between the inverter PCB and the control PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB aur control PCB ke darmiyan connection kharab

causes.en: External factors such as electrical noise.
causes.ur: Electrical noise jaisay external factors

causes.en: Defective inverter compressor or defective control PCB (transmission block).
causes.ur: Inverter compressor kharab ya control PCB (transmission block) kharab

solutions.en: Re-terminate and inspect the harness between the two boards; keep signal wires away from noisy power wiring.
solutions.ur: Dono board ke darmiyan harness dobara terminate karke check karein; signal wires ko shor dene wali power wiring se door rakhein.

solutions.en: Replace the faulty board (control or inverter) as the diagnosis indicates.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq kharab board (control ya inverter) badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Often clears after harness reseating (noise event).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Aksar harness dobara theek se lagane se theek ho jata hai (noise ki wajah se aaya tha).

title.en: Power voltage imbalance / open phase (inverter PCB)
title.ur: Voltage imbalance ya open phase (inverter PCB)

meaning.en: The supply has an open phase or unbalanced phases, or the main-circuit capacitor is faulty.
meaning.ur: Supply mein koi phase khuli hai ya phases unbalanced hain, ya main circuit ka capacitor kharab hai

causes.en: Open phase or interphase voltage imbalance in the power supply.
causes.ur: Power supply mein phase khuli ya phases ke darmiyan voltage ka imbalance

causes.en: Defective capacitor in the main circuit.
causes.ur: Main circuit ka capacitor kharab

causes.en: Defective wiring in the main circuit, or defective inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Main circuit ki wiring kharab ya inverter PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check all three phases at the supply and repair the utility/wiring fault (open phase).
solutions.ur: Supply par teenon phases check karein aur utility/wiring ki kharabi (khuli phase) theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the main-circuit capacitor; inspect main circuit wiring.
solutions.ur: Main circuit ka capacitor badal dein; main circuit ki wiring check karein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. In PK 3-phase supplies this is a real field risk - check supply before the unit.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. PK mein 3-phase supply par yeh asal field khatra hai - unit se pehle supply check karein.

title.ur: Switch box ke andar thermistor kharabi

meaning.en: A thermistor inside the outdoor switch (electrical) box read out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor switch (electrical) box ke andar lage thermistor ki reading had se bahar hai.

causes.en: Defective connection of the thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connection kharab

causes.en: Defective reactor thermistor.
causes.ur: Reactor thermistor kharab

solutions.en: Check the thermistor plug and lead routing inside the switch box.
solutions.ur: Switch box ke andar thermistor ka plug aur lead ka rasta check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the reactor thermistor if its resistance is off-spec.
solutions.ur: Reactor thermistor ki resistance ghalat nikle to use badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi se parafrase kiye gaye hain.

meaning.en: The outdoor supply has a reverse phase or an open (missing) phase.
meaning.ur: Outdoor supply mein phase ulti hai ya koi phase khuli (ghayab) hai

causes.en: Power supply reverse phase.
causes.ur: Power supply ki phase ulti

causes.en: Open T phase.
causes.ur: T phase khuli

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB (A1P).
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB (A1P) kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check phase sequence and fuses at the outdoor disconnect; correct the supply rotation.
solutions.ur: Outdoor disconnect par phase ki tarteeb aur fuses check karein; supply ki phase sequence theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor PCB (A1P) only if the supply is confirmed correct.
solutions.ur: Sirf tab outdoor PCB (A1P) badlein jab supply theek hone ki tasdeeq ho jaye

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Reverse phase can damage the compressor - stop the unit until corrected.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Reverse phase compressor ko nuqsan de sakta hai - theek hone tak unit band rakhein.

title.en: Transmission fault: indoor unit to remote controller
title.ur: Indoor unit aur remote controller ke darmiyan transmission fault

meaning.en: The indoor unit and its remote controller cannot exchange signals correctly.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit aur uska remote controller aapas mein signal theek se nahi bacha sakte.

causes.en: Transmission error between the indoor unit and the remote controller.
causes.ur: Indoor unit aur remote controller ke darmiyan transmission error

causes.en: Two main remote controllers connected (only one main remote allowed).
causes.ur: Do main remote controllers jude hain (sirf ek main remote ki ijazat hai).

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB, defective remote controller PCB, or noise.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab, remote controller PCB kharab, ya shor

solutions.en: Check the remote wiring polarity/terminals; remove the duplicate main remote if fitted.
solutions.ur: Remote ki wiring polarity/terminals check karein; doosra main remote laga ho to use hata dein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle both units; replace the remote or indoor PCB if the error persists.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka power cycle karein; error uske baad bhi rahe to remote ya indoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. The 'two main remotes' cause is a classic wiring mistake.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. 'Do main remotes' wali wajah wiring ki classic ghalti hai.

title.ur: Indoor units ke darmiyan transmission kharabi

meaning.en: Communication between indoor units (multi-split/centralised setups) failed.
meaning.ur: Indoor units (multi-split/centralised setup) ke darmiyan communication nakam hua.

causes.en: Faulty wiring between the indoor units.
causes.ur: Indoor units ke darmiyan wiring kharab

causes.en: External factor such as electrical noise.
causes.ur: Electrical noise jaisa external factor

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check inter-indoor transmission wiring for breaks/shorts and separate it from power wiring.
solutions.ur: Indoor units ke aapas transmission wiring mein kata ya short check karein aur use power wiring se alag rakhein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor unit PCB if the wiring tests good.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek nikle to indoor unit PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Multi-split / VRV indoor-branch systems only.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Sirf multi-split / VRV indoor-branch systems par.

title.en: Transmission fault: outdoor units or control adaptor
title.ur: Outdoor units ya control adaptor ke darmiyan transmission fault

meaning.en: Communication between outdoor units, or between the outdoor unit and its external control adaptor, failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor units ke aapas, ya outdoor unit aur uske external control adaptor ke darmiyan rabta khatam ya kharab ho gayi

causes.en: Connection error in transmission wiring between outdoor units.
causes.ur: Outdoor units ke darmiyan transmission wiring mein connection ki ghalti

causes.en: Connection error between the outdoor unit and the external control adaptor/storage unit.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit aur external control adaptor/storage unit ke darmiyan connection ki ghalti

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check and re-terminate the outdoor-to-outdoor / adaptor transmission wiring.
solutions.ur: Outdoor se outdoor / adaptor ki transmission wiring check karke dobara terminate karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor unit PCB if the wiring is sound.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek ho to outdoor unit PCB badlein

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Multi-outdoor (VRV/branch) installations.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Multi-outdoor (VRV/branch) installations ke liye.

title.ur: Remote controllers ke darmiyan transmission kharabi

meaning.en: Communication between main and sub remote controllers failed.
meaning.ur: Main aur sub remote controllers ke darmiyan communication nakam hua.

causes.en: Transmission error between the main and sub remote controller.
causes.ur: Main aur sub remote controller ke darmiyan transmission error

causes.en: Faulty connection between sub remote controllers.
causes.ur: Sub remote controllers ke darmiyan connection kharab

causes.en: Defective remote controller PCB.
causes.ur: Remote controller PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check the remote-to-remote wiring and terminations.
solutions.ur: Remote se remote wali wiring aur terminations check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the faulty remote controller if the wiring is good.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek ho to kharab remote controller badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Only on systems with sub remotes.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Sirf un systems par jin mein sub remotes hon.

meaning.en: Communication with another indoor/outdoor system (branch/refrigerant system No.2 side) failed.
meaning.ur: Kisi doosre system ke units se (branch/refrigerant system No.2 side) communication nakam hua.

causes.en: Transmission error between other indoor and outdoor units.
causes.ur: Doosre system ke units ke darmiyan transmission error

causes.en: Defective electronic expansion valve of the other indoor unit.
causes.ur: Doosre indoor unit ka electronic expansion valve kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB of the other indoor unit, or improper transmission wiring.
causes.ur: Doosre indoor unit ka PCB kharab ya transmission wiring ghalat

solutions.en: Check transmission wiring between indoor and outdoor units for correct connections.
solutions.ur: Wall aur condenser units ke darmiyan transmission wiring ke connections check karein.

solutions.en: Service the other system's indoor unit (EXV/PCB) as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq doosre system ke wall unit (EXV/PCB) ki servicing karein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Multi-system (System No.2) codes.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Multi-system (System No.2) ke codes hain.

title.en: Centralised control equipment address setting malfunction
title.ur: Centralised control equipment address setting kharab

meaning.en: The centralised control equipment address is duplicated or wrongly set.
meaning.ur: Centralised control equipment ka address dobara aa gaya ya ghalat set kiya gaya hai

causes.en: Address duplication of centralised control equipment.
causes.ur: Centralised control equipment ka address dobara ho gaya

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Re-assign unique addresses to every controller on the bus.
solutions.ur: Bus par har controller ko alag address dobara dein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor unit PCB if addressing is confirmed correct.
solutions.ur: Addressing theek hai yeh verify kar lein, phir indoor unit PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Centralised/VRV control layer - shown on the central controller.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh Centralised/VRV control layer ka code hai - central controller par nazar aata hai.

title.en: Indoor unit to centralised control transmission fault
title.ur: Indoor unit aur centralised control ke darmiyan transmission fault

meaning.en: The link to optional centralised-control equipment is broken (or the main-controller setting connector is disconnected).
meaning.ur: Optional centralised control equipment ka link toot gaya hai (ya main controller ki setting ka connector khula hai).

causes.en: Transmission error between optional controllers for centralised control and the indoor unit.
causes.ur: Centralised control ke optional controllers aur indoor unit ke darmiyan transmission error

causes.en: Connector for setting the main controller disconnected (or independent/combined changeover switch).
causes.ur: Main controller ki setting ka connector khul gaya hua hai (ya independent/combined changeover switch).

causes.en: Defective PCB for the central remote controller, or defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Central remote controller ka PCB kharab ya indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reconnect the main-controller setting connector and check the changeover switch position.
solutions.ur: Main controller ki setting ka connector dobara lagayein aur changeover switch ki position check karein.

solutions.en: Check bus wiring to the central controller; replace the central remote or indoor PCB as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Central controller tak bus wiring check karein; diagnosis ke mutabiq central remote ya indoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Centralised/VRV control layer.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Centralised/VRV control layer ka code hai.

meaning.en: Communication with an accessory device failed.
meaning.ur: Kisi accessory device se rabta nakaam ho gaya

causes.en: Defect in the accessory device itself.
causes.ur: Accessory device khud kharab hai

causes.en: Faulty wiring to the accessory device.
causes.ur: Accessory device tak ki wiring kharab

solutions.en: Check power and signal wiring to the accessory device; test the device independently.
solutions.ur: Accessory device ki power aur signal wiring check karein; device ko alag se test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the defective accessory device or repair its wiring.
solutions.ur: Kharab accessory device badlein ya uski wiring theek karein

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Accessory/option devices on VRV/Sky Air systems.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. VRV/Sky Air systems ke accessory/option devices ke liye.
